BOLLYWOOD AI (5 minutes)
This is the highest-energy content slide because every student in the room has seen these films.
OPENING HOOK — ASK (with full dramatic pause): SAY: "How many of you have seen RRR?" (Almost everyone will raise their hand) SAY: "Remember the massive battle scene at the beginning — with thousands of horses, soldiers, water everywhere? How many horses do you think were real?"
Let them guess. Common answers: "500" / "100" / "All of them"
REVEAL: "Almost none. The AI and VFX team composited nearly every horse. Even the water in parts of those scenes."
GO THROUGH EACH CARD: - RRR: "National Award winner. AI-made." - Brahmastra: "Every energy beam — pure AI rendering." - Shah Rukh: "The young SRK in Jawan? AI de-aging. His actual face was digitally rewound by 25 years." - Bahubali: "Mahishmati never existed. You visited a world that was built entirely inside a computer."
CONNECT BACK: SAY: "The same technology that created Mahishmati is the same technology we used 20 minutes ago to generate that picture from your 3 words. It's called a diffusion model. And now you know what it is."
This is a genuine 'wow' moment. Let it breathe.
